gloss: to hang; to suspend; to dangle

definitions.explanation: To attach something from above so it hangs down.

definitions.gloss: to hang up (for drying or storage)
definitions.explanation: To suspend items like clothes or food for practical purposes.

examples.japanese: {天井|てんじょう}から{照明|しょうめい}を{吊|つ}るした。
examples.english: I hung a light from the ceiling.

examples.japanese: {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{物干|ものほ}しに{吊|つ}るす。
examples.english: I hang the laundry on the clothesline.

examples.japanese: {風鈴|ふうりん}が{軒先|のきさき}に{吊|つ}るされている。
examples.english: Wind chimes are hung under the eaves.

notes:
{吊|つ}るす is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {吊|つ}る (to hang).

ASPECT ({ている}):
The passive form {吊|つ}るされている is commonly used to describe the state of something being hung ({絵|え}が{壁|かべ}に{吊|つ}るされている = 'a picture is hung on the wall').

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [object]を{吊|つ}るす (hang ~)
- [location]から{吊|つ}るす (hang from ~)
- [location]に{吊|つ}るす (hang on ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {天井|てんじょう}から{吊|つ}るす (hang from the ceiling)
- {壁|かべ}に{吊|つ}るす (hang on the wall)
- {洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{吊|つ}るす (hang laundry)
- {干|ほ}し{柿|がき}を{吊|つ}るす (hang persimmons to dry)
